nodes.label: Fairness Ledger Accumulated/Decayed/Capped
nodes.rationale: weighted_bump_days accumulates across all seasons with geometric decay (0.5/season) so repeat bumps compound; MAX_FAIRNESS_BONUS is derived to stay strictly below the urgency scale's granularity so fairness can tilt a close call but never outrank genuine urgency, enforced by a module-level assert plus a behavioral test.

nodes.label: Rain Urgency Boost Cannot Invert Urgency Ordering
nodes.norm_label: rain urgency boost cannot invert urgency ordering
nodes.rationale: Algebraic proof that min(1,x+b) is monotonic non-decreasing in x, so a sustained-rain urgency boost can compress a gap to a tie but never invert which plot is more urgent -- enforced by a comment beside MAX_FAIRNESS_BONUS's assert and a behavioral test of the worst-case pair.

nodes.label: Deterministic Core vs LLM Advocacy Split
nodes.norm_label: deterministic core vs llm advocacy split
nodes.rationale: All agronomy/scheduling math is deterministic Python, unit-tested, zero LLM involvement; Strands agents only rank under ambiguity, negotiate, and generate messages. No agent can produce a GDD/maturity/acreage/capacity number -- those are tool calls, not model completions. Makes 'did the LLM compute that number?' answerable as 'no'.

nodes.label: Pairwise Negotiation Capped at 3 Rounds
nodes.rationale: Contested plots pair sequentially by rank; a genuine, comparably-matched conflict that can't resolve after 3 rounds escalates to a human by design, not as a failure mode.

nodes.label: Lambda Shim for EventBridge to InvokeAgentRuntime
nodes.norm_label: lambda shim for eventbridge to invokeagentruntime
nodes.rationale: EventBridge Scheduler's universal target can't marshal InvokeAgentRuntime's blob-trait request body; a thin Lambda shim calling boto3 invoke_agent_runtime() handles it correctly instead.

nodes.label: Open-Meteo Forecast Horizon Gap Fix
nodes.rationale: Requesting the full 16-day forecast horizon returned a null on the not-yet-computed far day, hard-failing the watcher; fixed by trimming a trailing run of null days instead of treating it as a fatal gap.

nodes.label: Bedrock Prompt Caching (64% Cost Cut)
nodes.rationale: An explicit cachePoint block on the system prompt (not Strands' CacheConfig auto strategy, which cached at the wrong boundary) reduced a real 8-call scenario from $0.0227 to $0.0081.

nodes.label: Nova Pro Cannot Generate Valid Tamil Script
nodes.norm_label: nova pro cannot generate valid tamil script
nodes.rationale: Live-verified: 8 real advocate calls produced grammatically invalid consonant/vowel-sign clusters in valid Tamil Unicode -- a tokenizer-level limitation, not a prompting problem. Tanglish (romanized Tamil) came back mostly coherent by contrast.

nodes.label: advocate_argument Templated From Facts
nodes.rationale: Given the Tamil-generation failure, Tamil argument text is deterministically templated from structured facts instead of model-generated; concedes is still the model's genuine live decision.

nodes.label: Beat 6: Cost and Honesty Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Discloses measured per-run cost, that this is a simulated cluster on real coordinates, that the maturity threshold is a derived estimate, and that Tamil generation was tested and found unreliable so that field is templated instead.

nodes.label: GDD Anchored to transplant_date
nodes.rationale: Anchoring at transplant_date (not sowing_date) because it's a single memorable event a farmer can reliably report and matches the Plot entity model (a field's own microclimate). Breaks from a sowing-anchored ~1900 GDD placeholder.

nodes.label: ADT45 Maturity Threshold Derived Not Sourced
nodes.norm_label: adt45 maturity threshold derived not sourced
nodes.rationale: No TNAU/ICAR thermal-time figure for ADT 45 exists; derived from TNAU's 110-day crop duration minus a 20-day estimated nursery age, times an assumed GDD/day rate -- MATURITY_GDD_ESTIMATED=1575 initially, explicitly flagged as unverified.

nodes.label: Overripe Decay Linear Proxy
nodes.rationale: No citable maturity-indexed yield-loss curve for paddy was found (a search-hallucinated figure was caught and discarded); implemented as a linear ramp from 0 at maturity to 1.0 at DECAY_HORIZON_DAYS_ESTIMATED=20, explicitly DERIVED not measured.

nodes.label: GDD Rate Reconciled Against 5-Year Climatology
nodes.rationale: Phase 1's single-year sample (20.72 GDD/day) diverged from the brief's assumed 17.5; re-derived from 5 years of real Open-Meteo Archive data at Theni giving 19.2133 GDD/day, moving MATURITY_GDD_ESTIMATED to 1729.2.

nodes.label: TOO_GREEN Hard Exclusion
nodes.rationale: A plot below maturity threshold is removed from contention before ranking or capacity allocation runs, so it can never be silently overridden by capacity availability.

nodes.label: Theni Constant Renamed to Reference + Per-Cluster Calibration
nodes.norm_label: theni constant renamed to reference + per-cluster calibration
nodes.rationale: Applying the Theni-derived threshold to Thanjavur's real weather produces a measured ~9-day earlier maturity call; rather than just rename the constant, Cluster gains maturity_gdd_override derived per cluster from its own climatology.

nodes.label: CloudWatch Traces Are Not a Substitute for Persistence
nodes.norm_label: cloudwatch traces are not a substitute for persistence
nodes.rationale: Traces only exist where exported (deployed path only), have no recorded link from a plot/date to a trace ID, and have no retention policy -- Storage is the actual system of record, CloudWatch is operational telemetry.

nodes.label: System Computes Reasoning Then Discards It
nodes.norm_label: system computes reasoning then discards it
nodes.rationale: PlotDecision and AdvocateClaim/EscalationPayload are built fresh each trigger day and discarded; there is no put_decision anywhere in Storage. A reporting script can only be as honest as what it reads, so this is an architectural gap fixed at the source (DecisionRecord), not worked around in the reporting layer.

nodes.label: DecisionRecord Retained Indefinitely
nodes.rationale: No automatic deletion or season-rollover clearing -- an audit trail that quietly expires is not an audit trail, and this ADR exists because the system's previous audit trail (discard-after-use) already failed exactly that test.

nodes.label: Enrollment Bound to Initiating chat_id
nodes.rationale: The original proposal trusted callback_data alone as the enrollment credential; revised so every enrollment tap is checked against a pending state keyed by the chat_id that sent the original /operator command, since whether a forwarded keyboard can be tapped from another chat was unverified.

nodes.label: solve() Re-Competes FITS Plots Bug -> HARVESTED Outcome
nodes.norm_label: solve() re-competes fits plots bug -> harvested outcome
nodes.rationale: solve() recomputed every plot from scratch each trigger day with no concept of already-harvested, so a plot that fit early kept re-entering capacity contention. Surfaced by running the backtest across ~170 sequential trigger days (11 of 11 FITS plots regressed to CONTESTED). Fixed with mark_plot_harvested/clear_plot_harvest and a new HARVESTED PlotOutcome excluded before ranking, like TOO_GREEN.

nodes.label: No Season Entity; Rollover is Operator-Triggered
nodes.norm_label: no season entity; rollover is operator-triggered
nodes.rationale: No calendar-verified TN-wide season boundary exists to encode; season_id stays a plain externally-supplied string, and rollover is a deliberate, explicitly-triggered operator action, not a calendar-detected event.

nodes.label: Full Callback Authorization Audit
nodes.rationale: Escalation-resolve, confirmation, and rollover callbacks had no authorization check against the tapping Telegram identity, letting a stranger mutate the fairness ledger or answer on another farmer's behalf. Fixed for all three plus lang: (reconsidered and fixed rather than left as a documented exception).

nodes.label: Only Confirmed Drop Writes a LedgerEntry
nodes.norm_label: only confirmed drop writes a ledgerentry
nodes.rationale: Corrected on review: a pure reorder doesn't remove a farmer from today's harvest (the plot is already marked harvested at dispatch, before route order matters), so it has no fairness consequence; only a confirmed drop -- which un-harvests the plot -- writes a fairness bump.

nodes.label: Escalation Resolution Idempotency
nodes.rationale: A second tap on an already-resolved escalation answers 'already resolved' and does not re-process or re-notify -- a double-notification is a real trust cost.

nodes.label: not_ready as First-Class Distinct Message
nodes.rationale: An explicit reassuring message stating why the plot isn't ready and when it's checked again -- the concrete artifact of 'the agent telling farmers not to act,' meant to read as good news, not an error.

nodes.label: MSP/Moisture Constants Left None Until Sourced
nodes.norm_label: msp/moisture constants left none until sourced
nodes.rationale: agronomy/market_params.py's MSP_PADDY_COMMON_PER_QUINTAL and DPC_MOISTURE_THRESHOLD_PERCENT stay None -- never scraped, estimated, or model-generated -- until a real source-cited value is set by the user; the alert omits the price sentence entirely when unset.

nodes.label: Registration Never Persisted Farmer/Plot (Prerequisite Fix)
nodes.rationale: advance_registration/handle_incoming never called storage.put_farmer/put_plot; a completed registration left only an in-memory RegistrationState. Fixed by persisting at the COMPLETE transition using a HARVEST_CONVOY_CLUSTER_ID config value.

nodes.rationale: Live-verified reachable via bedrock-agentcore-control, but DynamoDB already serves the same structured queries this system needs; adding Memory would be decoration, not architecture.

nodes.label: Bounded-Window Undo for /linkfarmer
nodes.rationale: apply_link never deletes anything and touches exactly three plain fields, so reversing it within a 1-hour window is the same writes run backward, not a new merge primitive -- added after the initial 'no recovery' decision was reconsidered.

nodes.label: Operator-Only Proxy Registration, No Helper Role
nodes.norm_label: operator-only proxy registration, no helper role
nodes.rationale: A helper role would need its own provisioning, revocation, audit rows, and failure paths for a speculative need at eight-farmers-per-cluster scale -- building a general-purpose role system for a hypothesis is exactly the premature abstraction this project's discipline refuses elsewhere.

nodes.label: Reachability Decides Whether Rollover Prompt Is Written At All
nodes.norm_label: reachability decides whether rollover prompt is written at all
nodes.rationale: run_season_rollover previously wrote a SeasonRolloverPrompt even for an unreachable farmer, which -- under ADR-011's exclusion filter -- would silently and permanently exclude a designed-to-be-phone-less farmer from every future season. Fixed: no chat_id means no prompt is written at all, falling through to the existing 'no record = include by default' rule.

nodes.label: Operator Route Order Didn't Match Farmer route_position
nodes.norm_label: operator route order didn't match farmer route_position
nodes.rationale: The operator's route summary numbered plots by result.outcomes's incidental plot-id sort order, not route_position, so the operator and farmers could see three different numbers for the same route. Fixed as a standalone prerequisite before RouteOverride, so the new audit trail isn't built on a wrong sequence.

nodes.label: Why-Answers Use Stored DecisionRecord, Never Live Recompute
nodes.norm_label: why-answers use stored decisionrecord, never live recompute
nodes.rationale: project_maturity_for_plot() makes a live Open-Meteo call, so tapping the same old message twice could return two different answers to 'why wasn't my plot ready' -- exactly the failure explain_decision.py's own rule forbids. Everything is read from the DecisionRecord frozen at decision time instead.

nodes.label: Silence Recorded as Unknown, Never as No-Show
nodes.norm_label: silence recorded as unknown, never as no-show
nodes.rationale: Original Decision 6 draft credited a fairness bump for silence after a window; corrected during implementation -- only an explicit 'no' tap writes a ledger credit, an unanswered message is not evidence the machine failed to come.

nodes.label: Propose, Never Gatekeep (Separate Notification from Authority)
nodes.norm_label: propose, never gatekeep (separate notification from authority)
nodes.rationale: Holding the route for operator acceptance before notifying farmers was rejected: an unreachable operator would mean no farmer learns anything that day, a silent total failure worse than an occasional override. The agent still acts; only the operator's own message is framed as an editable proposal.

nodes.label: /help as the One Deliberate Farmer-Initiated Exception
nodes.norm_label: /help as the one deliberate farmer-initiated exception
nodes.rationale: A farmer-typed command fits neither 'agent speaks first' nor 'bounded one-tap reply' -- granted anyway because it's one exact matched string, a deterministic read of already-stored data, no keyboard, no follow-up, and explicitly not a precedent for a second command.

nodes.label: webhook.py Has No Live Entrypoint
nodes.rationale: The deployed AgentCore Runtime runs exactly one entrypoint, app.py's handler calling run_daily_watch -- no setWebhook call exists anywhere, zero API Gateways. Every farmer/operator-initiated feature since ADR-004 (registration, confirmations, escalation taps, route overrides, /help) is code-complete and tested but unreachable in production.

nodes.label: chat_id Float/Int Coercion Bug Found Live
nodes.norm_label: chat_id float/int coercion bug found live
nodes.rationale: DynamoStorage._from_decimal always cast to float; a farmer's real telegram_chat_id round-tripped as 1276258406.0, breaking every deployed Telegram send. Root-caused and fixed live during redeploy.

nodes.label: Half-Translation Bugs Found via Live Telegram Verification
nodes.norm_label: half-translation bugs found via live telegram verification
nodes.rationale: String-level review across 3 rounds declared Tamil 'closed'; only checking a real phone's receipt of the redeployed runtime found location_hint's English compass-direction tail and the invalid '1வது' ordinal -- proving reading rendered strings in isolation cannot catch every bug.

nodes.label: why_lost_text Doubled-Noun Grammar Bug Found Live
nodes.norm_label: why_lost_text doubled-noun grammar bug found live
nodes.rationale: why_lost_text's fallback winner_name built a doubled-noun phrase ('the selected plot's plot') in both languages when the winning plot's farmer couldn't be resolved; the existing test only asserted DEFAULT_WINNER_LABEL was a substring, which was true of the broken string too, so it didn't catch the doubling.

nodes.label: _from_decimal Value-Based Heuristic Wrong for Float Fields
nodes.norm_label: _from_decimal value-based heuristic wrong for float fields
nodes.rationale: DynamoDB Number type doesn't preserve int/float; _from_decimal decides the target type from the value alone, correct for telegram_chat_id but wrong for any float field holding a whole number -- affecting three of eight real Kamatchipuram plots' area_acres live.

nodes.label: Farmer View Wins When chat_id Is Both Farmer and Operator
nodes.norm_label: farmer view wins when chat_id is both farmer and operator
nodes.rationale: Reversed on review: the original draft checked operator status first, so an operator who also farms would never see his own plot through /help -- now the farmer view always wins, with an appended operator-commands addendum line.

nodes.label: Projected-Ready Date From AdvanceNoticeRecord Only
nodes.rationale: Rejects a live recompute for the same reason ADR-013 Part 3 does -- reads the same frozen AdvanceNoticeRecord.projected_maturity_date the farmer was already told, so two taps can't disagree.
